records.name: Figurteich
records.description_rewritten: Figurteich, also known as Figurenteich or Brown-Boveri-Teich, is a pond on the industrial edge of Wiener Neudorf/Guntramsdorf, south of Vienna. A naturist guide describes long-established nude bathing; this and a cruising-directory listing do not independently establish active gay cruising.
records.geographic_and_access_context: Figurenteich between Badner Bahn and Südbahn corridors by B17, Wiener Neudorf, Lower Austria; independent naturist guide reports GPS near 48.07156 N, 16.30808 E (not independently surveyed).
records.access_notes: Informal bathing pond with limited amenities, exact property rights and permitted recreation status to verify.

records.name: Swiss cottage - Cahir woods
records.description_rewritten: A wooded riverside approach near Swiss Cottage on the River Suir outside Cahir. The country cruising directory lists nearby woods rather than the heritage house itself. The house is a ticketed state heritage property, and its official website currently says it is closed until 2027; that does not establish closure of the public Coronation riverside trail.
records.geographic_and_access_context: River Suir / Swiss Cottage woodland by Ardfinnan Road, approximately 2 km south of Cahir, Tipperary; exact claimed cruising trail and access not located.
records.access_notes: Swiss Cottage heritage visitor building officially closed until 2027; adjacent public trail availability and property boundaries must be independently checked.

records.name: Seapoint-Western Cape-Sudáfrica
records.description_rewritten: Despite an obviously erroneous suffix naming South Africa's Western Cape, the listed directions refer to Dublin's DART railway and a coastal Martello tower. That matches Seapoint beach near Dún Laoghaire, Dublin. The name should be corrected at publication stage, but the original identifier is preserved. 2026 comments are requests about visiting, not confirmed visits.
records.geographic_and_access_context: Seapoint Beach, County Dublin, by DART and Seapoint Martello Tower; verify exact bridge and public access before map placement.
records.access_notes: Public, family-used coastal beach; tides, summer lifeguards and safe swimming/public behaviour requirements apply.
